title: Block to SoC: VIP Modes
description: Configure a block-level SPI agent into passive mode so it monitors traffic driven by an embedded processor without causing bus collisions.

steps.title: Step 1: Observe the Active Agent Failure
steps.instructions: Run `testbench.sv` without changes. Observe the `BUS_COLLISION` fatal error caused by the UVM Driver and Firmware driving simultaneously.

steps.title: Step 2: Flip to Passive Mode
steps.instructions: In `soc_test::build_phase`, use the `uvm_config_db` to set `is_active` to `UVM_PASSIVE` for the `"env.spi_agt"` path.

steps.title: Step 3: Verify Monitor Behavior
steps.instructions: Rerun the simulation. Verify the driver is disabled but the `[SPI_MON]` continues to log firmware traffic.
